from pathlib import Path
import sys,json,re,hashlib,subprocess
root=Path.cwd();sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'governance/compat'))
from build_dispatch_packet_scaffold import ScaffoldArgs
import build_worker_return_skeleton_scaffold as bws
import run_worker_return_scaffold as rws
import check_work_order_acceptance_ledger as ledger
import check_review_cost_control as cost
import check_worker_experience_retrospective as retro
cases=[]
def check(name,ok):
 cases.append({'caseId':name,'pass':bool(ok)});assert ok,name
def render(batch,profile,echo):
 a=ScaffoldArgs(packet_kind='generic-worker-dispatch',batch_id=batch,title='Local R1 probe',date='2026-10-04',base='6138edb56',commit_mode='WORKER_MUST_NOT_COMMIT',include_architecture_readiness_echo=echo,include_p4_observation_block=echo)
 a.worker_return_profile=profile
 return bws.build_worker_return_skeleton(a)
for profile,echo in ((rws.FULL_PROFILE,False),(rws.FAST_DOC_PROFILE,True)):
 a=render('WOAS-R3-GOLDEN',profile,echo);b=render('LOCAL-R1-ORACLE-517',profile,echo)
 check(profile+'-batch-invariant',a.replace('WOAS-R3-GOLDEN','ID').replace('woas-r3-golden','id')==b.replace('LOCAL-R1-ORACLE-517','ID').replace('local-r1-oracle-517','id'))
 check(profile+'-guidance-truthful-singular','Evidence completion guidance:' in a and a.count(retro.RETRO_TOKEN)==1 and a.count(retro.RETRO_NA_TOKEN)==0 and 'frictionLevel: TO_FILL_FROM_ACTUAL_EXECUTION' in a)
 check(profile+'-optout-boundary',('## Architecture Readiness Echo' in a)==echo and ('## P4 Automatic Evidence Observation Block' in a)==echo)
artifact='docs/reviews/local_r1_517.md';head=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()
wo='## Work-Order Acceptance Requirement Ledger\n```acceptance-ledger-json\n'+json.dumps({'schemaVersion':ledger.LEDGER_SCHEMA,'requirements':[{'requirementId':'LOCAL-517','mandatory':True,'expectedArtifacts':[artifact],'requiredProofIds':['LOCAL-P517']}],'proofCatalog':[{'proofId':'LOCAL-P517','kind':'COMMAND','locator':'Local direct consumer probe'}]})+'\n```'
for label,raw in [('dispatch-golden-full',render('WOAS-R3-GOLDEN',rws.FULL_PROFILE,False)),('standalone-fast',rws.build_scaffold('Local R1 517',rws.FAST_DOC_PROFILE))]:
 check(label+'-unfinished-refusal',bool(ledger.validate_return(wo,raw)) and not retro.diagnose(artifact,raw).is_clean)
 t=re.sub(r'(?m)^Status:.*$','Status: COMPLETE_PENDING_REVIEW',raw,count=1)
 evidence={'schemaVersion':ledger.EVIDENCE_SCHEMA,'executionBaseHead':head,'results':[{'requirementId':'LOCAL-517','actualArtifacts':[artifact],'proofRefs':['LOCAL-P517'],'status':'PASS'}]}
 t=re.sub(r'```acceptance-evidence-json\n.*?\n```','```acceptance-evidence-json\n'+json.dumps(evidence)+'\n```',t,count=1,flags=re.S)
 for field,value in {'rootCauseClusterId':'LOCAL-517','consolidatedDefectClassSweep':'COMPLETE_ALL_KNOWN_DEPENDENCIES','productionBindingEvidence':'LOCAL_OFFLINE_OBSERVABLE_PROOF','adversarialRegressionDisposition':'PASS_TARGETED_DEFECT_CLASS','terminalReadinessVerdict':'READY_FOR_REVIEW','frictionLevel':'LOW','frictionType':'KEYWORD_TRAP','observedStep':'Local isolated consumer sample','preventiveControlCandidate':'WORK_ORDER_TEMPLATE'}.items():
  t,n=re.subn(r'(?m)^'+field+r':.*$',field+': '+value,t,count=1);assert n==1,field
 check(label+'-completed-LOW',not ledger.validate_return(wo,t,{artifact}) and cost.diagnose_worker_return(artifact,t).is_clean and retro.diagnose(artifact,t).is_clean)
 na=re.sub(r'WORKER_EXPERIENCE_RETRO:\nfrictionLevel:.*?preventiveControlCandidate:[^\n]*',retro.RETRO_NA_TOKEN+' '+retro.RETRO_NA_REQUIRED_REASON,t,count=1,flags=re.S)
 check(label+'-completed-NA',retro.diagnose(artifact,na).is_clean)
 check(label+'-duplicate-refusal',not retro.diagnose(artifact,na+'\n'+retro.RETRO_TOKEN+'\n').is_clean)
 check(label+'-pending-ready-refusal',not cost.diagnose_worker_return(artifact,t.replace('productionBindingEvidence: LOCAL_OFFLINE_OBSERVABLE_PROOF','productionBindingEvidence: PENDING_BEFORE_READY')).is_clean)
preimage=subprocess.check_output(['git','show','438ee56b093b732b6b5ea01a8e27c1fa0c084d96:docs/reference/CVF_AGENT_WORK_ORDER_TEMPLATE_2026-05-19.md'],text=True,encoding='utf-8')
current=Path('docs/reference/CVF_AGENT_WORK_ORDER_TEMPLATE_2026-05-19.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
def exclude_guidance(t):return re.sub(r'(?ms)^Run the fast gate once while.*?(?=^Reviewer/committer validation)|^Early fast-gate runs.*?(?=^Reviewer/committer validation)','GUIDANCE\n\n',t)
# A removed unrelated blank is harmless but must not mask changed normative prose.
check('template-unrelated-prose-restored',exclude_guidance(preimage).split()==exclude_guidance(current).split())
check('template-no-growth',len(current.splitlines())<=1123)
source=Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8')
d={'schemaVersion':'cvf.wrsFr1R1LocalProbe@1','head':head,'disposition':'PASS_INDEPENDENT_PROBE','oracleSeparation':'Direct actual helpers and unchanged consumers, distinct Local IDs/options; no worker test imports/fixture oracle and no worker suite rerun.','cases':cases,'caseCount':len(cases),'probeSource':source,'probeSourceSha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
Path('.cvf/runtime/wrs-fr1-r1-local-independent-probe.json').write_text(json.dumps(d,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n');print(json.dumps({'status':'PASS','caseCount':len(cases)}))
